@paddedConstructionDistinguisher_move_answer_independent : ∀ {m queryCount : ℕ} (statement : Statement m)
  (receipt : Receipt m queryCount) (verdict : List (SpAnswer Rate Cap) → Bool) (left right : List (SpAnswer Rate Cap)),
  left.length = right.length →
    left.length < m + queryCount →
      (paddedConstructionDistinguisher statement receipt verdict).move left =
        (paddedConstructionDistinguisher statement receipt verdict).move right
@paddedFullMessageRoutingSafe : ∀ {m queryCount : ℕ},
  queryCount ≤ BabyBearExt4.modulus →
    ∀ (statement : Statement m) (receipt : Receipt m queryCount), PaddedFullMessageRoutingSafe statement receipt
@paddedWorkPrefix_succ : ∀ {m queryCount : ℕ} (statement : Statement m) (receipt : Receipt m queryCount) (round : ℕ)
  (hround : round < m + queryCount),
  paddedWorkPrefix statement receipt (round + 1) =
    paddedWorkPrefix statement receipt round + paddedRoundPrimitiveWork statement receipt ⟨round, hround⟩
@paddedWorkPrefix_final : ∀ {m queryCount : ℕ} (statement : Statement m) (receipt : Receipt m queryCount),
  paddedWorkPrefix statement receipt (m + queryCount) = paddedTranscriptPrimitiveWork statement receipt
@paddedWorkHybridRun_classify : ∀ {m queryCount : ℕ} (statement : Statement m) (receipt : Receipt m queryCount)
  (verdict : List (SpAnswer Rate Cap) → Bool)
  (coins : Fin (paddedTranscriptPrimitiveWork statement receipt) → Rate × Cap),
  (∃ state,
      workHybridRun (paddedConstructionDistinguisher statement receipt verdict) (0, 0) coins = Except.ok state ∧
        state.core.ans.length = m + queryCount ∧
          state.core.work = paddedTranscriptPrimitiveWork statement receipt ∧ state.remaining = []) ∨
    workHybridRun (paddedConstructionDistinguisher statement receipt verdict) (0, 0) coins =
      Except.error (WorkHybridError.hybrid PrefixHybridError.constructionMismatch)
@paddedRateSegment_lastRateCoin : ∀ {m queryCount : ℕ} (statement : Statement m) (receipt : Receipt m queryCount)
  (round : Fin (m + queryCount)) (coins : Fin (paddedTranscriptPrimitiveWork statement receipt) → Rate × Cap),
  lastRateCoin
      (List.map Prod.fst
        (List.take (paddedRoundPrimitiveWork statement receipt round)
          (List.drop (paddedWorkPrefix statement receipt ↑round) (List.ofFn coins)))) =
    (coins (paddedSegmentLast statement receipt round)).1
@paddedWorkHybridStep_constr_fresh_semantics : ∀ {m queryCount : ℕ} (statement : Statement m)
  (receipt : Receipt m queryCount) (verdict : List (SpAnswer Rate Cap) → Bool)
  (coins : Fin (paddedTranscriptPrimitiveWork statement receipt) → Rate × Cap) (round : Fin (m + queryCount))
  (state : WorkHybridState Rate Cap),
  state.core.ans.length = ↑round →
    state.remaining = List.drop (paddedWorkPrefix statement receipt ↑round) (List.ofFn coins) →
      PrimitivePathFresh state.core.ro state.core.primitive (0, 0) []
          (paddedPublicMessageSchedule statement receipt round)
          (List.map Prod.fst (List.take (paddedRoundPrimitiveWork statement receipt round) state.remaining))
          (List.map Prod.snd (List.take (paddedRoundPrimitiveWork statement receipt round) state.remaining)) →
        state.core.ro.lookup (paddedPublicMessageSchedule statement receipt round) = none →
          ∃ next,
            workHybridStep (paddedConstructionDistinguisher statement receipt verdict) (0, 0) state round =
                Except.ok next ∧
              next.core.ans = state.core.ans ++ [SpAnswer.rate (coins (paddedSegmentLast statement receipt round)).1]
@paddedWorkHybridStep_constr_lastRate_semantics : ∀ {m queryCount : ℕ} (statement : Statement m)
  (receipt : Receipt m queryCount) (verdict : List (SpAnswer Rate Cap) → Bool)
  (coins : Fin (paddedTranscriptPrimitiveWork statement receipt) → Rate × Cap) (round : Fin (m + queryCount))
  (state : WorkHybridState Rate Cap),
  state.core.ans.length = ↑round →
    state.remaining = List.drop (paddedWorkPrefix statement receipt ↑round) (List.ofFn coins) →
      ConstructionReturnsLastRate (0, 0) state.core.ro state.core.primitive
          (paddedPublicMessageSchedule statement receipt round)
          (List.map Prod.fst (List.take (paddedRoundPrimitiveWork statement receipt round) state.remaining))
          (List.map Prod.snd (List.take (paddedRoundPrimitiveWork statement receipt round) state.remaining)) →
        ∃ next,
          workHybridStep (paddedConstructionDistinguisher statement receipt verdict) (0, 0) state round =
              Except.ok next ∧
            next.core.ans = state.core.ans ++ [SpAnswer.rate (coins (paddedSegmentLast statement receipt round)).1]
@paddedWorkHybridStateNat_success_routing : ∀ {m queryCount round : ℕ} (statement : Statement m)
  (receipt : Receipt m queryCount) (verdict : List (SpAnswer Rate Cap) → Bool)
  (coins : Fin (paddedTranscriptPrimitiveWork statement receipt) → Rate × Cap),
  PaddedFullMessageRoutingSafe statement receipt →
    ∀ (hround : round ≤ m + queryCount) {state : WorkHybridState Rate Cap},
      paddedWorkHybridStateNat statement receipt verdict coins round hround = Except.ok state →
        state.core.ans.length = round ∧
          ∀ (future : Fin (m + queryCount)),
            round ≤ ↑future → state.core.ro.lookup (paddedPublicMessageSchedule statement receipt future) = none

@paddedDeferredWorkStep_constr_semantics : ∀ {m queryCount : ℕ} (statement : Statement m)
  (receipt : Receipt m queryCount) (verdict : List (SpAnswer Rate Cap) → Bool)
  (coins : Fin (paddedTranscriptPrimitiveWork statement receipt) → Rate × Cap) (round : Fin (m + queryCount))
  (state : DeferredWorkState Rate Cap),
  state.core.ans.length = ↑round →
    state.work = paddedWorkPrefix statement receipt ↑round →
      state.remaining = List.drop (paddedWorkPrefix statement receipt ↑round) (List.ofFn coins) →
        state.core.ro.lookup (paddedPublicMessageSchedule statement receipt round) = none →
          deferredWorkStep (paddedConstructionDistinguisher statement receipt verdict) (0, 0) state round =
            Except.ok
              {
                core :=
                  {
                    ro :=
                      (state.core.ro.respond (paddedPublicMessageSchedule statement receipt round)
                          (coins (paddedSegmentHead statement receipt round)).1).2,
                    sim := state.core.sim,
                    ans := state.core.ans ++ [SpAnswer.rate (coins (paddedSegmentHead statement receipt round)).1] },
                remaining := List.drop (paddedWorkPrefix statement receipt (↑round + 1)) (List.ofFn coins),
                work := paddedWorkPrefix statement receipt (↑round + 1) }
@paddedDeferredStateNat_head_semantics : ∀ {m queryCount round : ℕ} (statement : Statement m)
  (receipt : Receipt m queryCount) (verdict : List (SpAnswer Rate Cap) → Bool)
  (coins : Fin (paddedTranscriptPrimitiveWork statement receipt) → Rate × Cap),
  PaddedFullMessageRoutingSafe statement receipt →
    ∀ (hround : round ≤ m + queryCount),
      ∃ state,
        paddedDeferredStateNat statement receipt verdict coins round hround = Except.ok state ∧
          state.core.ans = List.take round (List.ofFn (paddedSegmentHeadAnswerSchedule statement receipt coins)) ∧
            state.core.sim = Oracle.empty ∧
              (∀ (future : Fin (m + queryCount)),
                  round ≤ ↑future →
                    state.core.ro.lookup (paddedPublicMessageSchedule statement receipt future) = none) ∧
                state.work = paddedWorkPrefix statement receipt round ∧
                  state.remaining = List.drop (paddedWorkPrefix statement receipt round) (List.ofFn coins)
